protocol.classification: development regression replay; not fresh model sampling or independent success-rate evaluation
protocol.configuration: Final auto runs exactly match original config_used.json, release_states.json, eligible destinations and saved model base poses. Earlier diagnostic runs restricted pair_slot_indices to [0,1]; they are retained separately.
protocol.timing: Action start to verification or failure, including computation and contact diagnostic sampling overhead. Not a performance benchmark.
protocol.scoring: Simulation truth only after actor exit. Initial visual target XY matched uniquely to a released body within 25 mm; other released bodies must be over 100 mm away. Final XY is scored against assigned goal. Parked displacement is start-to-end only.
protocol.execution: Original Panda GraspGen base poses replayed via transfer-replay.py; RGB-D, FK, joint drives, physical contact and final visual acceptance live. No carton teleporting, binding or truth-fed control.
limitations: Only two separated upright cartons with right lane occupied
No general collision-free guarantee, new-scene success rate, multi-carton sorting or real robot validation

8130.reason: Both panda_hand collision spheres 37 and 42 (zero based) violate 8 mm clearance. Endpoint gap 2.492970 mm makes retiming the original paths insufficient.

kinematic_crosscheck.scope: Independent FK on Lula descriptor spheres verifies the implicated pair; custom finger spheres and path clearance are handled by the live controller, not this offline crosscheck.

8130.fix: Reject before motion; orient cartons at separated pickup positions before translating; retain all clearance thresholds.

8131.reason: Occluded scene view footprint matched medium; cross-view fusion ignored catalogue size disagreement and ranked inflated clipped coverage first. Empty pregrasp did not refresh history; new ID and mismatched size/centre failed reacquisition; 9.342 s reference exceeded 6 s before current fit.

8131.fix: Resolve complete-view size disagreement with current multi-view measured extent, otherwise UNKNOWN. Renew pregrasp reference from current observed pose. Expired fallback also requires unique current support height, two-view full pose and two-frame motion check, followed by original grasp revalidation.

8131_follow_on.reason: After original preclose failure was fixed, a parked-carton side fragment was required to contain its own top patch, missing another camera current top depth.
8131_follow_on.fix: Permit current top depth from another view only after all current fragment masks pass the existing reference-surface checks; retain guarded collision envelope and final independent acceptance.
